_doc: V3.1 slice 4 — middle-loop golden corpus seed. Per SPEC.md §Verification Design row 554 + memory/CARDS.md card 4 §Verification Approach. The harness that runs these tuples against the live AI SDK adapter is its own slice (not built yet); this file is the seed the runner will consume. Each seed describes one (source change, target content, relation kind) → expected classification tuple. The label vocabulary is bounded by I114; proposals are advisory text, never auto-applied. Add to this file as new representative cascades emerge from outer-loop walkthroughs.

seeds.source_previous: Users authenticate with email and password.
seeds.source_current: Users authenticate with email and password.
seeds.target_current: Login page accepts email + password and validates against the auth service.

seeds.source_previous: User profiles store name, email, and role.
seeds.source_current: Customer profiles store name, email, and role.
seeds.target_current: The user dashboard displays the user's name and email at the top.

seeds.source_previous: Passwords must be at least 12 characters long.
seeds.source_current: Passwords must be at least 8 characters long.
seeds.target_current: The signup form rejects passwords shorter than 12 characters with a clear error.

seeds.source_previous: The system supports CSV import for contacts.
seeds.source_current: The system supports CSV import for contacts. Counterexample: malformed CSV with embedded newlines must be rejected with a row-level error.
seeds.target_current: The contacts page has an Import button that opens a file picker.

seeds.source_previous: Order totals are verified by reconciling against the upstream payment gateway sandbox.
seeds.source_current: Order totals are verified by reconciling against the upstream payment gateway production API in shadow mode.
seeds.target_current: The order-total invariant is checked nightly by the sandbox-reconciliation job.
